explanations.name: Custom program error 6001
explanations.meaning: Program-defined error 6001 (0x1771). Codes 6000 and up are defined by each program, so the meaning depends on which program failed.
explanations.fix: Find the failing program (explain_tx shows it) and look up this code in that program's IDL or docs.
